get.description: Return the formation's activity feed, newest first, with ULID cursor paging. The feed covers checklist changes only — status changes, assignment, notes, links, skip reasons and template work. Permission changes never appear here: nothing keeps a history of them, since each save overwrites the previous state. Pass item_uid to narrow the feed to one item's history. A cursor belongs to the sequence that produced it, not to the feed generally: a next_cursor from a filtered read is only valid when replayed with the same item_uid, and one from an unfiltered read only without one. Mixing them is not rejected and does not error — it returns a correct page of a different sequence, which is the dangerous outcome, so a caller must carry the filter alongside the cursor.
